title: Forbidden TAI(s) for the list of "forbidden tracking areas for  regional provision of service"

entities.name: Forbidden TAI(s)
entities.description: Indicates the forbidden TAI(s) to be stored in the list of 'forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service'. This IE is included only if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.

entities.name: Satellite E-UTRAN access condition
entities.description: Condition that the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.

entities.name: Forbidden TAI storage in regional service list
entities.description: Property indicating that forbidden TAI(s) are stored in the list of 'forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service'.

relations.description: The Forbidden TAI(s) IE is included only when the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access.
The Forbidden TAI(s) IE indicates that forbidden TAI(s) should be stored in the list of 'forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service'.
